scores.notes: Tea table under the tree with Alice leaning toward the drowsy Dormouse, Hare and Hatter; scene fits, but the pocket-watch dials on the table (right) and on the grass (bottom right) carry numeral marks.
Card courtiers and card hoops carry corner index letters/numerals; the Queen's red-bodice, yellow heart-panel skirt and tall white collar closely follow the Disney animated costume.
Holmes at the bay window holds the blue stone up with Watson seated right and strong box present; posted notes on the wall (upper left) show scribbled text marks and mantel clocks show numerals.
Wide camp view with the tabernacle centered under a resting cloud and families among tents; watercolor edges fade to bare paper at left and bottom-right corners (accepted).
Card-soldier guards at the door are human soldiers in heart tabards, not flat cards; floor papers carry text lines; a second Alice look-alike girl in blue pinafore stands in the crowd bottom left.
Holmes and Watson before the pawnbroker's corner with three gilt balls, but the board reads 'PAWNBROKER' with pseudo-text above it and a signature appears bottom left.
The father runs arms-wide toward the viewer while the son walks behind him on the right, so he is not running to meet the son; figures are large, not small and centered.
Daniel at left raises a hand toward the seated Belshazzar with a faint glowing hand on the wall and nobles at feast tables; no writing on the wall, edges painted.
Daniel and Belshazzar in a glazed-brick hall, but glowing pseudo-script glyphs are written on the wall beside the hand (center).

David in tunic after releasing the sling, Goliath in scale armor toppling in a dust cloud between massed armies; he stumbles sideways rather than clearly face-first; paper white at bottom-right edge (accepted).
Goliath already lies head-down on the ground while David still holds the stone in a Y-shaped slingshot fork (upper center), contradicting the release.
Elisha walks alone up the road toward Bethel's gate and calf shrine while youths spill out at right pointing and jeering; no lettering or anatomy issues seen.
Alice stands centered on a shingle beach between the Mock Turtle and Gryphon, who step and wave forepaws around her; no lettering.
Row of weathered stone markers receding down a limestone village street, largest at left, villagers passing and a Roman soldier by a wall at right; markers carry no inscriptions.
A cloaked ruler on scaffolding points as laborers heave a stone block into a broken wall, with basket carriers and armored overseers; dust and receding wall fit.
Moses sits on a rock flanked by Aaron and Hur above the battle, but his arms are lowered holding a staff and are not raised or held up by them.
Holmes at the door with Watson and red-haired Wilson by the fire; the newspaper on the desk (bottom right) has a pseudo-text masthead and columns, and floor papers show text.

Holmes at the window with brougham outside and Watson half-rising by the fire fits; a paper on the floor (bottom left) shows written lines and the mantel clock shows numerals; white paper edges top/right (accepted).
The father runs arms-wide down the road toward the weary son who lifts a hand, villagers watching from doorways, Galilee lake beyond; paper shows at bottom-right edge (accepted).
Plainly dressed villagers on the slope facing the dusk sky, one lifting a hand, walled town and shore beyond and a red-cloaked soldier on the road; bare paper on left and bottom edges (accepted).
An old man lies on a woven mat with hands folded while family kneel and stand in grief at a tent opening, well, fields and mud-brick town behind.
Darius kneels at the pit rim reaching down with attendants holding rope and lamp; Daniel stands unharmed among calm lions, raised lid and banded gate present.
A dome of golden radiance breaks through black cloud over dark water with no figure or face in the light.
Isaiah looks up at two winged seraphim with wings over faces and lower wings near their feet in a smoky pillared hall; one holds tongs with a coal, but God appears only as radiance and cloud.
Daniel stands calm between closed-mouthed lions beside a glowing angel, Darius leaning over the barred gate above with a torch.
Holmes kneels with lens and lantern while Merryweather sulks on a crate, but the crates carry stenciled pseudo-text (left and right).
